fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.qtype_zh: 指数增长/衰减求值（翻倍、等比）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A shuttlecock kicked under the plane trees follows h = -t² + 16t. What is h when t = 4?
questions.q_zh: 梧桐树下踢起的毽子高度是 h = -t² + 16t，t = 4 时 h 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A shuttlecock kicked under the plane trees follows h = -t² + 10t. What is h when t = 2?
questions.q_zh: 梧桐树下踢起的毽子高度是 h = -t² + 10t，t = 2 时 h 是多少？

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: A shikumen is a ____.
questions.q_zh: 石库门是____。
questions.explain_en: It is a stone-gated Shanghai house.
questions.explain_zh: 石库门是有石门框的里弄房子。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海生活（梧桐/黄浦江/石库门）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a Lujiazui grid map, Flora is at (-3, -2) and the zongzi stall at (2, 10). What is the straight-line distance?
questions.q_zh: 陆家嘴坐标图上 Flora 在 (-3, -2)，粽子摊在 (2, 10)，直线距离是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a Lujiazui grid map, Flora is at (-2, -2) and the zongzi stall at (6, 13). What is the straight-line distance?
questions.q_zh: 陆家嘴坐标图上 Flora 在 (-2, -2)，粽子摊在 (6, 13)，直线距离是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The number of sachets is a² + 5a. Find it when a = 2.
questions.q_zh: 香囊数量是 a² + 5a，求 a = 2 时的值。

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: Riding from Lujiazui to the Bund, Flora crosses to the other side of the Huangpu in the story's scene change. Which pair is correct?
questions.q_zh: 故事里 Flora 从陆家嘴来到外滩，是到了黄浦江的另一边。下面哪一对是对的？
choices: Lujiazui is in Pudong; the Bund is in Puxi
The Bund is in Pudong; Lujiazui is a village abroad
Both are in a desert oasis
Both sit on a high mountain pass
choices_zh: 陆家嘴在浦东，外滩在浦西
外滩在浦东，陆家嘴在国外村子
questions.explain_en: Lujiazui is a Pudong area; the Bund is on the Puxi waterfront.
questions.explain_zh: 陆家嘴在浦东，外滩在浦西滨江。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海生活（梧桐/黄浦江/石库门）

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: On the Bund, Flora sees a far drummer's arm move, then hears the beat. The delay is because ____.
questions.q_zh: 在外滩，Flora 先看见远处鼓手的手臂动了，然后才听到鼓声。这是因为____。
choices: drums make no sound over water
sound is much slower than light
sound is much faster than light
the river deletes the first beat
choices_zh: 江把第一下鼓声删掉了
questions.explain_en: You see the motion almost at once; the sound takes longer to arrive.
questions.explain_zh: 动作的光几乎立刻看到，鼓声要晚一点才传到。
questions.qtype_zh: 声与光（龙舟鼓/江面回声）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A bird over the Bund rises with height h = -2t² + 10t (in metres). What is h at t = 1?
questions.q_zh: 外滩上空一只鸟的高度是 h = -2t² + 10t（单位：米），t = 1 时 h 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Two zongzi sellers at Xintiandi: one charges 10 + 6x yuan, the other 28 + 4x yuan for x zongzi. For what x do they cost the same?
questions.q_zh: 新天地两家卖粽子：一家 x 只收 10 + 6x 元，另一家收 28 + 4x 元。x 是多少时两家价钱一样？
questions.qtype_zh: 两边都有未知数的方程

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Zongzi are set out in waves at Xintiandi: 4 at first, and the number set out multiplies by 2 each wave. How many are set out in wave 7, after 6 multiplications?
questions.q_zh: 新天地的粽子一波波摆出：开始 4 只，每一波是上一波的 2 倍。乘了 6 次之后（第 7 波）摆出多少只？
questions.qtype_zh: 指数增长/衰减求值（翻倍、等比）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a city grid (units of 10 m), the Bund flood wall is at (-1, 1) and Flora's e-bike is at (7, 16). What is the straight-line distance in grid units?
questions.q_zh: 在市区坐标图上（单位 10 米），外滩防汛墙在 (-1, 1)，Flora 的电动车在 (7, 16)，两点直线距离是几个单位？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: From the foot of a flag pole on the Bund, a rope runs to a point 12 m along the deck; the pole is 9 m tall. How long is the rope from the top of the pole, in metres?
questions.q_zh: 外滩一根旗杆高 9 米，从杆顶拉一根绳子到地面离杆脚 12 米的地方，绳长多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Last year 200 visitors watched the dragon boats from the Bund. This year there are 15% more. How many visitors are there this year?
questions.q_zh: 去年有 200 位游客在外滩看龙舟，今年多了 15%，今年有多少人？
